sourceText:
Best Dessert Ever
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 12:30am

Ingredients




1 baked devil's food cake
2 sm. instant chocolate pudding
3 1/2 cups milk
1/4 cup kahlua
16 ounces Cool Whip
4 Heath bars or Skor

Preparation

1 Bake cake in 9 x 12 inch pan according to the directions. Let cool. Mix pudding, milk and kahlua and put aside. 2 In a large, see-through bowl, layer cake (broken into large bite-size pieces), pudding mix, Cool Whip and candy pieces (crushed). Continue layering until all is used. Sprinkle top with candy pieces. Serves 16-20.
